row.evidence: BrowserStack's pricing page puts Single Sign-On and Auto Provisioning ("Add and delete users automatically from your identity provider") in the Enterprise column ("Inquire for Pricing"), and the SCIM docs list "Enterprise plan on BrowserStack" as a prerequisite.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: SCIM and SAML SSO only on Enterprise, which the pricing page sells as an add-on to any plan ("Inquire for Pricing"). Live Desktop is $29/mo billed annually for a single user (Desktop & Mobile $39); Live Team $150/mo and Team Pro $249/mo billed annually, multi-user. SSO must be enabled before SCIM. SCIM is user-only (no group provisioning); deactivating a user in the IdP deletes the BrowserStack user and reactivation creates a new one. The June note's '25+ user minimum' and '$12k-$40k/yr' figures have no first-party source and were dropped. User Management REST API is Enterprise-only and needs Support to enable.

plans.name: Live Desktop
plans.notes: Enterprise features (SSO, auto provisioning, APIs) are available as an add-on.

plans.name: Live Team
plans.notes: Multi-user plan with a user-count selector (5, 10, more than 10); the user count the $150 price covers is not stated in the page text.

plans.name: Enterprise (add-on)
plans.notes: Sold as an add-on on top of a product plan. SSO and Auto Provisioning check marks appear only in the Enterprise column of the comparison table (read from page markup).

auth.token_source: Account > Security > Authentication > Auto User Provisioning > Configure (Owner, or an Admin the Owner delegates)
auth.notes: Bearer token (Access key) or HTTP Basic (User name + Access key); BrowserStack does not enforce one.

deprovision.notes: Setting active=false (IdP deactivation) deletes the user from the BrowserStack account; re-activation creates a new user with a new id. The Owner cannot be deleted via the IdP.

filtering.notes: ServiceProviderConfig reports filter supported with maxResults 500; filterable attributes are not listed. Sort and ETag are not supported.

custom.how: Extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Bstack:2.0:User with bstack_role (User/Admin/Owner), bstack_team and bstack_product (multi-valued product access); Okta maps the role to primary_role.

roles.how: bstack_role custom attribute (User, Admin, Owner); team via bstack_team and product access via bstack_product.

limitations.text: No group provisioning: users only; team, role and product access are set per user via custom attributes.
SSO must be enabled before user provisioning.
Deactivation deletes the user; re-activation creates a new user with a new id.
The Owner cannot be deleted via the IdP; ownership must be reassigned first.
Users already in another BrowserStack organization must be deleted there before they can be provisioned.
Provisioning fails when the product's licences are used up.
Once enabled, users can only be invited and managed through the IdP; the Invite modal is removed and pending invites become invalid.

auth.notes: HTTP Basic with BrowserStack username and access key; Owner or Admin role required.

capabilities.notes: create_user adds the user directly with no invite. 'Groups' are BrowserStack teams. disable_user revokes product access and role but keeps the user in the account.

endpoints.purpose: List users, or get one user with ?email=
Create and add a user (no invite sent)
Change a user's primary and additional teams
Disable a user (revoke all access, keep in account)
Delete a user from the account

audit_log_api.notes: Covers a subset of audit events.

rate_limits.text: 5-request burst, then 15 requests per minute (one every 4 seconds); 429 when exceeded.

limitations.text: Users, Teams and Usage Reports APIs must be enabled by BrowserStack Support.
Audit Logs API covers only a subset of audit events.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate as checked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Gallery app is named 'BrowserStack Single Sign-on'.

onelogin.notes: From BrowserStack's own OneLogin guide; OneLogin's connector page was not loaded.
